cross_platform.note: N-02 Docker smoke and prior local Y-02 smoke establish two-platform B0 operation. N-02 comparison/pipeline failed in its immutable evidence. Wider Y-05 desk runs are different sequences, so no paired speed/quality comparison is claimed.

heldout.reason: No downloaded held-out input; user deadline 3.5 hours; no held-out tuning or claims

limitations: Development succeeds on only about 76% of frozen inputs under the native OK-state criterion; pose ATE is conditional on available/associated poses.
Four process runs completed; this does not mean tracking never failed.
Three repeated development trials, one 50-frame selection trial; selection repeatability/generalization not established.
GT scale is fitted for evaluation only, not recovered metric scale.
No held-out evaluation under user deadline; no new model/fusion benchmark in Y-05.
Peak RSS is individual-process OS accounting, not concurrent process-tree memory.
No real-time claim; tracking latency excludes decode and post-call output.

protocol.gt_reference: all GT rows inside fixed input window +/- 20ms; ambiguous fr2 duplicate is outside selection50 interval
protocol.rpe_delta: one matched causal pose row, excluding pairs crossing non-OK/missing-pose gaps
protocol.rss: OS-reported peak individual-process child RSS; not summed concurrent worker RAM
protocol.scale: one global Sim(3), evaluation-only; separate final/causal gauges
protocol.throughput: frozen input frames / complete runner wall clock including startup and export

run_order: selection50, development573 x3; sequential fresh runner processes

evaluation_gt.rule: all GT rows within frozen input time bounds +/- 20ms; no pose averaging/deduplication/tuning

runs.failure_interpretation: Tracking/relocalization states are observed; underlying cause is a hypothesis. Native blur flags are correlates, not proof of the cause.

resource_scope.cold_start_reason: time to first tracked frame is not instrumented; whole-run wall clock is reported separately
resource_scope.effective_fps_scope: validated frozen input frames / whole-run wall clock, including startup/export
resource_scope.peak_rss_scope: RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss; maximum individual-process RSS reported by OS, not concurrent process-tree RAM; descendant accounting OS-dependent
resource_scope.wall_clock_scope: whole B0 runner child: preflight, startup, tracking, export and shutdown; no warm-up excluded

baseline.notes: Candidate WP2 baseline: upstream classical defaults, Python sparse core, no learned depth/semantics. Runtime and quality not yet validated.
